To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
IS development is a social process that is shaped by organizational and political factors.

IS development methodologies are used in a way that is inconsistent with their stated purpose, but that they nevertheless provide a useful framework for understanding IS development and a useful starting point from which to develop more effective methodologies.

IS development is a complex, dynamic process that involves a variety of actors, each with different interests, and that traditional IS development methods are not very effective in the detailed, daily work of IS development.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new approach to the development of systems.
the process of information system development in a large, decentralized, multi‐site, multi‐divisional organization.
the development of information systems, the development process itself and the development of methodologies to support the process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
IS development is an inherently complex and messy process.
IS development methodologies are used as a fiction to provide a symbolic and/or controlling image.
the development of IS is not an exact science and that the development of methodologies to support this process is not a simple or straightforward task.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the development of an information system is an emergent process in which the system is shaped by the interactions between a number of actors and the environment.
the study of the process of IS development is an important area of research that has been under‐exploited.

the study of information systems (is) development in a field setting is an interesting and worthwhile exercise, which can provide insights and understanding of the process that are of use to practitioners and theorists alike.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the IS development methodology is not a static entity, but rather is a process that is continuously evolving.
IS development is a social process that is not well served by the mechanistic approach to development methodologies.
IS development methodologies are not used in the way that the literature suggests.
